description: This file defines a React functional component 'EditorPage' which serves as a scaffold for a post editor page in a blog platform. It handles routing parameters for post ID, distinguishes between creating a new post and editing an existing one, and renders placeholder UI elements for the editor.

methods.name: EditorPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the editor page UI, including header and placeholder content, and retrieves the postId route parameter.
